extracted.name: Easy Dinner Hash
extracted.description: This easy hash recipe can be easily scaled to feed any number of people. I use it when it’s just my daughter and me home for dinner.
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir sausage in hot oil until crumbly and just slightly pink, about 5 minutes. Add potato and onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender and lightly browned, 10 to 15 minutes.
Stir in frozen vegetables and cook until heated through. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese to serve.
